title: 有效搭讪的关键：私密距离

timeline.summary: A man stops a masked woman, states that he wants to meet her, compliments her and requests WeChat after she says she has something urgent.
They remain standing together and exchange school/work, age, study, origin and appearance talk; speaker turns and several ASR words remain uncertain.
He proposes a next-weekend meeting; she says timing is uncertain, after which he asks about other men and frames competition.
They discuss zodiac signs, say they can talk on WeChat, mention that she needs to find friends, and close with a request to send a contact note.
No reliable ASR; formal visual review classifies the final window as the same plaza interaction followed by the ending, not proof of contact or follow-up.

claims.speaker: field man, identity not independently verified
claims.statement: He states his approach intention directly and gives appearance-based reasons for wanting to meet.
claims.conditions: Case behavior only; directness does not create an obligation to stop, converse or share contact information.

claims.speaker: field participants, turns partly uncertain
claims.statement: When the woman says she has an urgent matter and prefers talking online, the interaction shifts toward a WeChat request.
claims.conditions: Her time limit must be honored without pressure. Sparse footage and an unreadable phone do not prove voluntary contact exchange.

claims.speaker: field man
claims.statement: He proposes meeting the next weekend, receives uncertainty, and leaves the arrangement for later WeChat discussion.
claims.conditions: Uncertainty is not acceptance. Questions about other suitors and competition must not be used to pressure a decision.

examples.summary: One edited plaza interaction moves from a direct introduction to personal information and a future invitation; it does not show a later reply or meeting.

speaker_attribution.speaker: field man
speaker_attribution.basis: Visible red-hooded participant; formal source did not independently prove that he is Mikey, so claims remain role-attributed.

speaker_attribution.speaker: approached woman
speaker_attribution.basis: Masked woman visible throughout; short turns are inferred from exchange structure but are not formally diarized.

visual_findings: All three sampled frames show the same two people standing in one public plaza location; there is no visible case change.
The woman is masked but otherwise identifiable by clothing, body and location; bystanders are visible and publication consent is unknown.
The samples show continued standing conversation, not a readable contact-save screen, confirmed follow-up or later meeting.

permissions.reason: Duplicate formal source with uncertain speaker identity, contact outcome, age turns, privacy and pressure boundaries.

limitations: Automatic transcript was not word-for-word audio checked or diarized.
Three 45-second samples do not equal continuous audio-visual review.
Contact exchange, later replies and meeting outcome are not verified.
The public participant's filming and publication consent are unknown.
